title: On the Jung-van der Kulk decomposition into Pascal finite factors
summary: Combining the Jung--van der Kulk theorem with the conjugacy invariance of the Pascal finite class, we show that every polynomial automorphism $F$ of the plane over an arbitrary field $K$, satisfying $F(0) = 0$, decomposes into the form $F = \diag(\det J_F, 1) \circ P_1 \circ \dots \circ P_s$, where all $P_i$ are Pascal finite automorphisms. Since every Pascal finite automorphism has Jacobian determinant equal to 1, the diagonal factor is the only obstacle: $F$ is a composition of Pascal finite maps if and only if $\det J_F = 1$.
